narrative.overview: A native instrument in the supplied dark blue-gray material. Embedded Inter, recessed panels and restrained trace colors preserve the Clip Pocket identity while giving spectral comparison the largest area.
keyCharacteristics: Before/after spectra above the added residual spectrum.
A separate Short / Integrated measurement panel with Reset; no Momentary meter.
A fixed native window and a quiet dark radial chassis.
dos: Do retain Clip Pocket Solid Dark and embedded Inter.
Do keep Before green, After blue and residual amber.
Do keep Short and Integrated in their separate panel.
Do preserve native host/OS scaling and meaningful accessible descriptions.
donts: Don't label residual as true THD, loudness or transfer response.
Don't add decorative animation or a custom OpenGL context.
